description: This file implements the ControlModuleService class and related factory functions for managing IPC control modules, including client connection handling, shared memory retrieval, and control registration within the Rialto media server project.

classes.name: IControlModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating control module service instances.

classes.name: ControlModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Concrete factory class for creating ControlModuleService instances.

classes.name: ControlModuleService
classes.description: Implements the control module service handling client connections, shared memory, and control registration.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to a new ControlModuleServiceFactory instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new ControlModuleService instance with provided playback and control services.

methods.name: ControlModuleService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service with playback and control service references.

methods.name: ~ControlModuleService
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up controls associated with connected clients.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Handles new client connection, exports the service to the client.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles client disconnection, removes associated controls.

methods.name: getSharedMemory
methods.description: Retrieves shared memory information via the playback service.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a new client, assigns a control ID, and adds it to the control service.

methods.name: ack
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment requests for control operations.
